role: The block-callback worklist's run loop: a step's emitted calls are pushed so they run in emission order before the step's frame resumes; the entry points push one frame and run the stack down to where it was; the order checks (an op emitted outside a run, a read after an emit) abort.
gpu: the run loop is a while over the env's frame stack with a switch per op kind: no recursion, no allocation
notes: The steps themselves live beside the code they port: world.c (set_block_step, notify_step, chest_added_step), blockcb.c (the callbacks and their continuations), features_springs.c (liquid_step, static_step), ticks.c (the schedule and the falling block).
